info.title: WatchLog API
info.description: The public WatchLog API: what an API token can read, for Kubernetes clusters and Docker fleets. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (Settings → API tokens). Stability (ADR-126): additions may come in any release. A breaking change comes only with /api/v2, or after a deprecation that lasts two minor versions. Routes not listed here are the dashboard's own and may change without notice.

bearerAuth.description: A personal API token (`wl_pat_…`), read only.
